name: Serpentine Bloodline (Bloodrager Bloodline)
body:
Your ancestry of ophiduan beings runs deep.

Bonus Feats: Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Dirty Trick, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Spring Attack

Bonus Spells: blade lash (7th), mirror image (10th), vampiric touch (13th), naga shape (16th)

Bloodline Powers
Serpent’s Maw (Ex)

At 1st level, you grow fangs. These fangs are treated as a natural weapon dealing 1d6 points of damage plus your Strength modifier (1d3 if you are Small) plus poison (Bite— injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 your bloodrager level + your Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1 Con damage; cure 1 save). At 4th level, these fangs are considered magical for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and the poison damage increases to 1d2 Con. At 8th level, your poison requires 2 successful saves to cure. At 12th level, your poison damage increases to 1d4 Con. At 16th level, your venom ignores any immunity to poison that targets possess. At 20th level, your poison deals damage to any two ability scores of your choosing rather than just to Con.

Serpent’s Scales (Ex)

At 4th level, you gain a +1 natural armor bonus to AC as well as a +2 bonus on Acrobatics checks, Escape Artist checks, and saving throws against poison. At 8th level, your natural armor bonus increases to +2 and the skill and save bonuses increase to +4. At 16th level, your natural armor bonus increases to +4, the skill bonuses increase to +8, and you gain immunity to poison.

Serpentine Tenacity (Ex)

At 8th level, you gain a climb speed equal to twice your base speed, the compression ability, darkvision 60 feet, and the ability to perceive invisible creatures as see invisibility.

Envenomed Rage (Su)

At 12th level, while bloodraging, all of your attacks with both natural and manufactured weapons are considered to be coated in your venom from serpent’s maw.

Snakebleed (Su)

At 16th level, whenever you take damage while bloodraging, you may cause a venomous snake swarm to pour forth from your injury into your space. The snake swarm uses the poison from your serpent’s maw ability in place of its own poison, and the DC of its distraction ability is equal to the DC of your serpent’s maw poison. You are immune to abilities of the swarm and may command the actions of the swarm (as per dominate animal), but it dissipates after 1 round.

Serpentine Supremacy (Su)

At 20th level, you gain the shapechanger subtype and can assume the form of a reptilian humanoid (as alter self), a snake of Diminutive to Huge size (as beast shape III), or a naga (as naga shape III) at will. You retain the power of speech and the ability to use somatic spell components when transformed and can use your serpent’s maw and serpentine tenacity abilities while under the effects of a polymorph spell.
